passive.name: Protector's Virtue
passive.text: HP increased by **20/25/30/35/40%**. Additionally, provides an ATK Bonus based on **1.2/1.5/1.8/2.1/2.4%** of the wielder's Max HP.

passive.name: Mistsplitter's Edge
passive.text: Gain a **12/15/18/21/24%** Elemental DMG Bonus for all elements and receive the might of the Mistsplitter's Emblem. At stack levels 1/2/3, the Mistsplitter's Emblem provides a **8/16/28% | 10/20/35% | 12/24/42% | 14/28/49% | 16/32/56%** Elemental DMG Bonus for the character's Elemental Type. The character will obtain 1 stack of Mistsplitter's Emblem in each of the following scenarios: Normal Attack deals Elemental DMG (stack lasts 5s), casting Elemental Burst (stack lasts 10s); Energy is less than 100% (stack disappears when Energy is full). Each stack's duration is calculated independently.

passive.name: Undying Admiration
passive.text: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by **16/20/24/28/32%** and Elemental Skill CRIT Rate by **6/7.5/9/10.5/12%**.

passive.name: Ironbone
passive.text: Increases Elemental Skill CRIT Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%**. Additionally, increases Energy Recharge by **16/20/24/28/32%** for 5s after using an Elemental Skill.

passive.name: Iwakura Succession
passive.text: After casting an Elemental Skill, gain 1 Succession Seed. This effect can be triggered once every 5s. The Succession Seed lasts for 30s. Up to 3 Succession Seeds may exist simultaneously. After using an Elemental Burst, all Succession Seeds are consumed and after 2s, the character regenerates **6/7.5/9/10.5/12** Energy for each seed consumed.

substatLine: CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG > Energy Recharge > ATK%
skillPriority: Elemental Burst > Elemental Skill > Normal Attack

entries.name: Foreign Rockblade
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Starfell Sword
entries.text:
You disgorge a meteorite from the depths of the earth, dealing **AoE Geo DMG**.
The meteorite is considered a **Geo Construct**, and can be climbed or used to block attacks.

**Hold**
This skill's positioning may be adjusted.

You spoke with Paimon about the final destination of falling stars.

entries.name: Wake of Earth
entries.text:
Energizing the Geo deep underground, you set off expanding shockwaves.
Launches surrounding opponents back and deals **AoE Geo DMG**.
A stone wall is erected at the edges of the shockwave.
The stone wall is considered a **Geo Construct**, and may be used to block attacks.

You and Paimon studied the pulse of the mountains.

entries.name: Frenzied Rockslide
entries.text: The final hit of a Normal Attack combo triggers a collapse, dealing 60% of ATK as **AoE Geo DMG**.

entries.name: Foreign Adamantine
entries.text:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional **buffs**.

Additionally, when nearby party members become protected by a shield, when the shield is replaced for any reason, or when **Geo Constructs** are created, the Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Archaic Petra, max 3 stacks. Up to 1 stack may be obtained every second in this way. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Archaic Petra, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Archaic Petra and transform into the special **Charged Attack: Rockfell**.

**Charged Attack: Rockfell**
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased **Geo DMG**. Increase in DMG is equal to 120% of Traveler's ATK.
· For 15s after hitting an opponent, nearby party members will have their shield strength temporarily increased by 20%.
· **Charged Attack: Rockfell** can be triggered up to once every 15s.

entries.name: Invincible Stonewall
entries.text: Party members within the radius of **Wake of Earth** have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption.

entries.name: Rockcore Meltdown
entries.text: When the meteorite created by **Starfell Sword** is destroyed, it will also explode, dealing additional **AoE Geo DMG** equal to the amount of damage dealt by Starfell Sword.

entries.name: Will of the Rock
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Wake of Earth** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Reaction Force
entries.text:
The shockwave triggered by **Wake of Earth** regenerates 5 Energy for every opponent hit.
A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

entries.name: Meteorite Impact
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Starfell Sword** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Everlasting Boulder
entries.text:
The barrier created by **Wake of Earth** lasts 5s longer.
The meteorite created by **Starfell Sword** lasts 10s longer.
